_comment: Tier-2 for dune::mixed_methods#3. Measured 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2) on an 8x8 Lagrange-on-Lagrange mixed pair (RT cannot be a product leg on this install, which is mixed_methods#0). With the potential as the NATURAL datum entering through u_D*dot(tau,n)*ds the system solves and the datum is live: changing u_D from 0 to 1 shifted the potential by exactly 1.000000 on average. Adding a DirichletBC on the POTENTIAL component instead also converged, and changed the solution — so it looks like a working boundary condition while constraining an L2-type field. TWO SIBLING CLAIMS ARE NOT COVERED and the run prints why. mixed_methods#5 says the equal-order pressure mode does not shrink under refinement; measured here it FELL by about 120x (7.883657e+13 -> 6.547007e+11) on this pair, the opposite of the claim. mixed_methods#6's accuracy half could not be separated: the residual proxy gave 1.204958e+00 for both the direct solve and GMRES, so only the iteration-count half (1 against 1710) is evidence, and that alone does not carry the claim. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 runs the GMRES probe with the direct UMFPACK solver, removing the unpreconditioned Krylov method on the saddle-point system. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'gmres_costs_more_iterations=True', 'dune_mixed_method_traps_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
